title: Qt: Rework Follow Stream Dialog
description:
The Follow Stream dialog relied on updatePackets always completing
immediately (and taking up the entire thread) instead of being
event driven like other dialogs, so 6f85fc6895911b8e369cdddbdc932efe4af1dee1
broke it. Switch it to event driven like the other dialogs (though
it still removes its tap after completion, and only responds to its
own taps.)

Instead of always replacing the main display filter with the follow
filter, replace the "Filter Out This Stream" button with "Prepare as
Filter" and "Apply as Filter" buttons, as used elsewhere in the
application. Have the "Back" button close the window and restore the
main filter to the original filter when the window was opened, if
changed (instead of sometimes the previously filtered out filter.)

Fixes #16290
